summary: Approach the masked camp, survive the Tree King’s blood-sport sentence, escape through Moth’s silent intervention, and flee into the forest under pursuit

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Moth

## Summary

A slight masked acolyte of the Tree King, mute like the rest of the host and distinguishable only by a moth-wing notch in the left cheek of the wooden mask.

## Appearance

Wrapped in bark-cloth, barefoot despite the cold, with a whitewood mask and one finger missing from the right hand.

## Voice

Moth never speaks. Communication is limited to gestures, breath, and occasional involuntary grunts.

## Goals

Keep the Tree King from using the prisoners in the blood ring and create one unobserved opening without revealing open rebellion.

## Private pressure

Moth is Lio Vane, a Harrowcross road guard taken two seasons earlier and partially bound by an amber-backed mask. Removing it may kill him.

## Author notes

Moth leaves the pen open and the bone key visible. The party does not learn the true name during this arc.

frontmatter.title: Hilltop Dawn

observations.text: The hill overlooks forest in every direction without road smoke, farm clearing, or the River Keld.
The dawn angle places them far north and east of every mapped road in Pip's case.
Jorund's map and Pip's underground route cannot be reconciled with any known surface contour.
A narrow column of smoke rises two valleys north from a camp where animal-faced figures move in silence.
The unmasked figure's root crown contains amber that pulses in time with the reliquary under her coat.
The camp has sentries but no casual voices, cooking quarrels, children, dogs, or tethered stock.

author_constraints: The party approaches because it lacks food, direction, and another human option.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Hilltop Dawn

The apparent escape ends with a rational but perilous approach to the only visible camp. Silence, animal masks, and amber resonance foreshadow capture without giving the party a plausible alternative.

operations.title: The Root Host Captures the Frontiersmen
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Root Host Captures the Frontiersmen

The company descends under a white cloth. Masked figures rise from spruce wells and moss-covered pits without speech or warning. Rootjaw strikes the earth once; root cords snap around ankles and wrists while Moth catches the reliquary before it hits stone.

operations.title: The Root Host Confiscates the Party's Gear
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Root Host Confiscates the Party's Gear

The masked host removes weapons, maps, badges, amber, and the Sunken Hall reliquary. They sort the gear by smell and resonance rather than ownership. Moth hides the bone key while placing Pip's map on top of the bundle.

frontmatter.title: Camp Under Wooden Faces

observations.text: Dozens of wooden animal faces turn toward the descending party, but not one camp voice answers the white cloth.
The masks exaggerate prey eyes and predator mouths into expressions no living animal could hold.
Rootjaw gives one low grunt and six hidden acolytes move at once.
The camp has human tracks but no ordinary domestic pattern: no children, livestock, loose tools, or unmasked sleepers.
The cord around the gear bundle uses an obsolete Lantern Pike field knot.
The amber behind every mask brightens when the Sunken Hall reliquary passes nearby.
The moth-notched acolyte is missing one finger and hesitates before tightening Rhea's wrist cord.

author_constraints: The Root Host remains mute except for nonverbal grunts.
The party has not yet heard the Tree King's name or purpose.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Camp Under Wooden Faces

The capture is spatially earned by the host's prepared pits and the party's exhaustion. The camp itself is not a settlement but a military organism built around masks and silence.

operations.title: The Tree King Claims Communion with the Frontier
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Tree King Claims Communion with the Frontier

The captives are brought before a throne grown from living spruce roots. The Tree King identifies himself as former Lantern Pike field-master Aldren Veyl, accuses Halric of selling damped memory as currency, and demonstrates that his root crown resonates with the party's reliquary.

operations.title: The Tree King Decrees Blood Sport
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Tree King Decrees Blood Sport

Aldren orders the five outsiders into the Blood Ring. He states that fear and injury strengthen amber-backed masks, while death leaves a fuller impression. The party is to fight Rootjaw and whatever the ring calls until one side no longer rises.

operations.title: Rootjaw Demonstrates the Amber Mask
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# Rootjaw Demonstrates the Amber Mask

Rootjaw cuts a captive boar, presses the blood to the amber plate inside his mask, and fights the wretch that rises from the animal's panic. When he crushes it, the mask plays the boar's scream and his shoulders swell beneath the rawhide.

value.title: The Tree King's Offer

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: Welcome, Lantern Pike. Halric sends better questions than soldiers now.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: He did not send us to you.

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: He sends everyone to me when he sends them after what amber remembers.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: You know the guild knot.

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: I tied it before your lodge-master learned to make silence look like policy. Aldren Veyl, then. Tree King, now.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The crown is routing impressions from the masks into you.

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: Communion. The Frontier lends me every hunted life the guild grinds into coin.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: A chorus is not consent. Memory is not a crown.

turns.speaker: char_5P1T0F31DJHKZHBC49XEHCX891
turns.text: [a low warning grunt]

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: The masks do not require consent from what is already dead.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Some of it is not dead. The fish avoided the roots. The forest avoids your camp.

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: The weak always call attention to wisdom when they mean fear.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: What do you want from us?

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: Blood, terror, contest. The survivor strengthens my host. The fallen strengthen it more completely.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: You make murder into a tool and call the tool a kingdom.

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: I make strength from what the guild wastes. You will enter the ring tomorrow and teach the masks five new shapes.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: And if the amber chooses a different vessel?

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: Then I will finally have an heir worth fearing.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: char_4CMM4NQV0GXRD5J73ZVC3BQTKN
turns.text: The ring is more patient than you are.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Tree King's Offer

Aldren names his former guild role, offers his theology of communion, tempts Veyra, and condemns the party to blood sport.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: Audience of the Tree King

observations.text: Raw amber in the root crown brightens in different places as masked acolytes shift behind the prisoners.
Aldren's old hood carries the same field knot as the Lantern Pike gear bundle, worn and re-tied many times.
The crown draws pressure from each mask through root cords under the court and returns a stronger pulse.
Several masks exhale animal panic when Aldren calls their stored forms communion.
The moth-notched acolyte flinches when Rhea refuses, then deliberately looks away from the pen gate.
Rootjaw's demonstration leaves seventeen armed masks around the ring and only four guarding the gear shelter.

author_constraints: Aldren's communion is materially real but his claim of chosenness remains interpretation.
The party receives testimony about the Blackroot concealment but no documentary proof.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Audience of the Tree King

The antagonist articulates a coherent indictment of the guild and a monstrous conclusion: because amber stores violence, he believes more violence is the proper means of sovereignty.

recollection.summary: The Tree King is former Lantern Pike field-master Aldren Veyl. He uses blood sport to feed terror and defeated forms into amber-backed masks and plans to use the party tomorrow.
recollection.interpretation: Aldren knows real guild secrets but has turned that knowledge into a system of domination.

recollection.summary: Aldren claims the Frontier lends him hunted lives, but the living forest avoids his camp and Moth reacted to Rhea's refusal.
recollection.interpretation: His communion is extraction from the forest, not mutual relation with it.

recollection.summary: Aldren treats remembered forms as dead matter that cannot withhold consent and strengthens masks through blooded combat.
recollection.interpretation: He has confused access to pain with moral authority over it.

recollection.summary: The root crown routes impressions from every mask into Aldren, and he believes amber may choose her as a stronger vessel.
recollection.interpretation: His offer proves amber can distribute memory through a controlled lattice, but accepting his premise would make people into inputs.

recollection.summary: Aldren Veyl tied Lantern Pike field knots before Halric and openly describes Halric's concealment as policy.
recollection.interpretation: The former field-master is a living witness to the guild secret, though not a trustworthy one.

recollection.summary: The new Lantern Pike company carries a living reliquary, a translator the amber answers, and a leader who refuses ceremonial fear.
recollection.interpretation: Their resistance will either produce unusually strong masks or a worthy successor.

recollection.summary: Rhea refused the Tree King quietly after learning the ring would consume the party's fear and dead shapes.
recollection.interpretation: An unmasked outsider may still choose something the mask cannot predict.

value.title: Before the Blood Ring

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: The pen latch is root cord around a bone tooth. I could open it if I had the tooth or a smaller hand than mine.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Gear first, north palisade second. We do not enter the ring.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: The moth mask changes guard at moonrise and never tightens the left hinge.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The reliquary is under the bark shelter. The crown pulls at it even closed.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: If the masks store fear, panic during escape arms the pursuit.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Good. I was worried calm had no tactical use.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We leave together. No challenge, no revenge, no experiments.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: I agree so emphatically that I resent the order.

turns.speaker: char_5P1T0F31DJHKZHBC49XEHCX891
turns.text: [two warning grunts from beyond the pen]

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Moth is watching the gear shelter, not us.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Then someone else may also be choosing.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Before the Blood Ring

The party plans around the root latch, gear shelter, mask resonance, and the need to control fear. Moth remains outside the transcript because he never speaks.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

operations.title: Moth Leaves the Prison Pen Open

effects.value: left in prison latch; taken by Pip

operations.bodyMarkdown:
# Moth Leaves the Prison Pen Open

At the final dark watch, Moth replaces the root cord without seating it, leaves the carved bone key in the hinge, and gives one involuntary grunt when Pip notices. He walks away without looking back.

frontmatter.title: Blood Ring Pens

observations.text: The pen is held by braided living root around a carved bone tooth, not by metal lockwork.
Masks hanging near the ring breathe fragments of previous captives' panic whenever the drums begin.
Moth checks every binding except the left hinge and repeats the omission on three rounds.
The root crown's distant pulse tugs at the closed reliquary through the bark shelter wall.
Only four masked guards remain between the pen, gear shelter, and north palisade during ring preparation.
Moth leaves the bone tooth unseated and the root cord resting loose across it.

author_constraints: Moth's action is intentional, but the party cannot know why or who he was.
The party's escape plan prioritizes cohesion over attacking Aldren.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Blood Ring Pens

The prison act makes the escape a product of observation, discipline, and one silent internal rebellion rather than convenient negligence.

recollection.summary: The party agreed to recover essential gear and leave together without entering the ring or attacking Aldren.
recollection.interpretation: Fear control is now a material part of tactics, not only morale.

recollection.summary: Moth repeatedly left the left hinge loose and watched the gear shelter rather than the prisoners.
recollection.interpretation: The acolyte may be resisting the host from inside the mask's constraints.

recollection.summary: The masks replay prior captives' panic, so uncontrolled fear during escape could strengthen the pursuit.
recollection.interpretation: Calm has become an act of mercy toward one another and denial toward the host.

recollection.summary: Aldren's crown continues pulling at the reliquary while it is closed and out of sight.
recollection.interpretation: The artifacts belong to compatible parts of one network; distance reduces but does not sever the link.

recollection.summary: The root latch needs the bone tooth, Moth deliberately leaves one hinge loose, and four guards cover the gear route.
recollection.interpretation: The escape is being offered by someone who cannot speak openly and may pay for discovery.

operations.title: The Frontiersmen Slip Out of the Blood Ring Pens
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Frontiersmen Slip Out of the Blood Ring Pens

Pip lifts the unseated bone tooth and peels the living cord from the hinge. The party exits one at a time between drumbeats, breathing in count so the nearby masks do not brighten.

operations.title: The Party Recovers Essential Gear

effects.value: rifled; contract, wages, frost sample, and empty lamp remain

operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Party Recovers Essential Gear

They reach the bark shelter and cut only the outer bundle. Badges, map, broken spear, and reliquary are recovered; the signed contract, amber wages, frost sample, and empty mine lamp remain beneath the guard rack when Rootjaw returns early.

operations.title: The Root Host Raises the Pursuit Alarm
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Root Host Raises the Pursuit Alarm

Rootjaw discovers the open pen and strikes his quickened cudgel against the root court. Every mask in the camp releases a different animal cry. Aldren answers through the crown, sending the host north and east in practiced hunting lines.

operations.title: The Root Host Pursues the Frontiersmen
operations.bodyMarkdown:
# The Root Host Pursues the Frontiersmen

The party crosses the north palisade and enters rain-black spruce. Behind them the host advances without spoken orders, guided by drumbeats and the brightening reliquary. Sylvi chooses a flooded game trail where masks cannot keep formation, but Rootjaw's cudgel calls wretch cries from the ground.

frontmatter.title: The Open Pen

observations.text: Moth gives one involuntary grunt when Pip takes the bone key, then turns his mask toward the ring.
The loosened root cord curls back toward the empty pen as if trying to remember its shape.
Four guards cover the gear shelter; two face the ring whenever the drums peak.
The contract and amber wages are tied beneath the heaviest guard rack and cannot be reached without waking the camp.
The reliquary pulls toward Aldren's crown until Veyra wraps it in wet bark and charcoal cloth.
Every wooden mask cries in a different animal voice when Rootjaw strikes the earth.

author_constraints: Moth remains behind and his fate is unknown.
The party recovers enough gear to survive, not every possession or piece of evidence.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Open Pen

The escape pays off the party's observations, emotional discipline, and Moth's silent choice. Leaving possessions behind makes the flight materially costly.

value.title: Running Under the Drums

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Direction.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: North ridge, then east into water. The masks cannot spread in the flooded spruce.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: My map has achieved complete freedom from the landscape.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Save the complaint for ground that is not trying to remember our feet.

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: The reliquary is pulling west. Aldren is using it as a compass.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Can you break the link without opening it?

turns.speaker: char_48QC9B4M2RFVXJKSDFMRGJWG8Y
turns.text: Charcoal, running water, and no terror. I can offer two of those.

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: Stream ahead. Thirty breaths.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Moth's key has three notches. One is shaped like a road marker.

turns.speaker: char_671MWM7KTP4DCVVP8EP6SFRJVP
turns.text: Then remember the helper without inventing the reason.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: We owe him an escape, not a name.

turns.speaker: char_5P1T0F31DJHKZHBC49XEHCX891
turns.text: [a distant boar-like bellow through the rain]

turns.speaker: char_0NQKTG3NQZFSVFKXS901NJD82E
turns.text: They have cut south of us. The host knows the water route.

turns.speaker: char_1W0GNKETQY2HF88YHM7CWVFH7C
turns.text: Then the third notch may be theirs, not ours.

turns.speaker: char_36X0KBYZ7MQGKM070H5NF12BK8
turns.text: Keep it. Keep moving. We learn what it opens when we are not being hunted.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# Running Under the Drums

The active escape conversation keeps route choice, artifact resonance, and the unknown helper in motion while the host closes around the party.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.

frontmatter.title: The Hunt Begins

observations.text: Cold rain erases ordinary tracks but every reliquary pulse leaves a brief gold reflection in puddles.
Masked pursuit lines remain unnaturally straight until forced into flooded spruce.
Moth's bone key has three notches: pen tooth, triangular road mark, and an unfamiliar hooked cut.
The closed reliquary tugs west in time with distant root-crown pulses.
Rootjaw's distant bellow carries several older animal cries under the boar voice.
A second drumline sounds south of the party, proving the host knows or predicts the water route.

author_constraints: The Root Host is actively pursuing; the party has not escaped the campaign threat.
Moth's identity and the key's other uses remain unresolved.
The route back to Harrowcross remains unknown.

value.bodyMarkdown:
# The Hunt Begins

The requested story ends in motion: the company has escaped captivity but not the Frontier, and the enemy's silent host is adapting to every route choice.

# The Frontiersmen

## Public premise

The Frontier is a remote boreal peninsula reached through Keldmouth, a port at the mouth of the River Keld. Monster-hunting guilds protect caravans and settlements while gnome dowsers locate near-surface pockets of strange liquid-gold amber. New hires Rhea Marrow, Sylvi Ashdown, Brother Garran Holt, Veyra Kest, and Pip Fenlock arrive expecting paid caravan work and discover a frontier economy whose currency, monsters, and institutions are entangled.

## Current canonical state

At tick 195 the five new guild hunters are running north through rain-black spruce. The Root Host is behind them, Moth's bone key is in Pip's hand, their gear is only partly recovered, and none of them knows a safe route back to Harrowcross.

## Author truth

Amber is not ordinary mineral. It is hardened memory-sap from the buried Heartwood Below, a vast ancient living network beneath the peninsula. Fresh blood, concentrated fear, and abrupt fracture can make raw amber 'quick,' releasing stored predator and victim impressions as ethereal animal-wretches that move through walls and ground. The Lantern Pike guild documented this at Blackroot and concealed the correlation while accepting amber for protection services. Former field-master Aldren Veyl rejected the concealment, survived catastrophic exposure, and became the Tree King. He correctly learned to call and strengthen manifestations with blooded amber, then mistook access to accumulated memory for divine kingship. Secret marker: FRONTIER-SECRET-AMBER-ROOT-MEMORY-7K4M.
